title: Occupant Killer
caption: Ukraine. Voxel world. Build, command and fight across twelve stages.

title: Hostomel Airport
caption: Open the campaign on the sprawling airfield, gatling gun in hand.

title: Bakhmut Ruins
caption: Rust-red rubble and blue supply crates set the stage for close urban war.

title: Avdiivka Sector
caption: Hurl Molotov cocktails through the shattered grey high-rises of Avdiivka.

title: Kherson Crossing
caption: Wade the flooded blue river banks and plant C4 among the occupiers.

title: Mariupol Steelworks
caption: Push through the burning red Azovstal steelworks under heavy boss fire.

title: Chornobyl Zone
caption: Hold the toxic green exclusion zone as the horde closes in fast.

title: Sevastopol Naval Base
caption: Towering armoured occupants storm the naval base beneath a clear sky.

title: Belgorod Offensive
caption: Swarmed at point-blank range while a BTR-82A APC bears down.

title: Siege of Kyiv
caption: Defend the capital as an Assault Walker boss rolls into view.

title: Saky Airbase Strike
caption: Storm the crimson airbase, jeeps and infantry pouring across the tarmac.

title: Antonov Bridge Strike
caption: Detonate the enemy line in a blast of fire on the bridge approach.

title: FGM-148 Javelin
caption: Lock the Javelin onto armour rolling through the Avdiivka streets.

title: NLAW Launcher
caption: Shoulder the NLAW over the flooded crossing and hunt enemy armour.

title: RPK-74 Firefight
caption: Rake advancing infantry with the RPK-74 on the airport apron.

title: AK-74M Advance
caption: Push the AK-74M forward across the blue voxel wetlands of Kherson.

title: AGS-17 Grenade MG
caption: Lob automatic grenades into occupier cover amid the Bakhmut ruins.

title: FN P90
caption: Clear rubble strongpoints with the compact FN P90 in tight quarters.

title: Stugna-P ATGM
caption: Guide the Stugna-P anti-tank missile down the airport trench line.

title: Bakhmut Demolition
caption: Race the demolition clock through the wreckage of Bakhmut.

title: Kherson Overwatch
caption: Sidearm ready, scan the teal floodwaters of the Kherson crossing.

title: Kherson Anti-Armour
caption: Set up a Stugna-P shot across the sunken blue voxel channels.

title: Avdiivka Armour
caption: Ukrainian-flagged armour rolls up beside you in the Avdiivka sector.

title: DShK Drone Recon
caption: Call in recon drone overwatch and mark targets from above the battlefield.

title: Tactical Overwatch
caption: Command the fight from a bird's-eye drone view as squads engage.

title: Steelworks Assault
caption: Enemy waves charge across the dark maroon floor of the steelworks.

title: Sevastopol Skyline
caption: Deploy at the naval base under wide open coastal skies.

title: Belgorod Boss Fight
caption: Face down the BTR-82A APC as the offensive kicks off.

title: Chornobyl Last Stand
caption: The zone glows red as the final boss wave crashes against your line.

title: Victory
caption: All stages cleared, all occupants eliminated. Total voxel victory.
